recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片骨小樑之間幾乎全是脂肪，只殘存少量散在造血細胞小灶，對 8 歲兒童而言屬明顯低細胞量；下方為血塊組織，對兒童全血球減少應想到兒童頑固性血球減少症與再生不良性貧血的鑑別。
features: Low-power bone marrow core with intact bony trabeculae
Markedly hypocellular intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by adipocytes
Only small patchy foci of residual hematopoietic cells
Separate fragments of clotted blood/aspirate material below the core
Cytologic dysplasia not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypocellular intertrabecular spaces composed predominantly of adipocytes with only small patchy foci of residual hematopoiesis, which is well below the expected cellularity for an 8-year-old. Fragments of clotted blood are present separately. Dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of pancytopenia and a clonal karyotypic abnormality (der(5)t(1;5)), findings are consistent with hypocellular refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia lacks unequivocal megakaryocytic or granulocytic dysplasia and patchy erythroid islands with left shift, and usually lacks clonal karyotypic abnormalities such as monosomy 7.
Fanconi anemia, dyskeratosis congenita, and GATA2 deficiency require chromosome breakage testing, telomere length, and germline sequencing.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts, which can be excluded by CD34 immunostaining and aspirate differential.
